method.value: Open-Meteo archive, daily max/min temperature and precipitation, 2020-11-29 to 2024-12-09, filtered to Nov 29 to Dec 9 each year (55 days per stop). Wet day = more than 1.0 mm.

results.value: Miami 78/65 20%; Great Stirrup Cay 77/74 15%; Cabo Rojo 87/72 16%; Aruba 85/79 60%; Curaçao 85/78 58%; Falmouth 83/73 47%; Grand Cayman 83/78 42%
results.notes: Physics check (class A): reanalysis grids count light drizzle, and the Aruba/Curaçao points may sit over water, so the wet-day share likely overstates noticeable rain. The pack says a short shower counts the same as a wet day.
